packet.title: Private monthly trip packet
packet.description: Off by default. Review confirmed business drives and matched receipt references before downloading. Browser-local categories and route suggestions do not count as consent.
packet.vehicle: Select a vehicle to prepare a private packet.
packet.signIn: Sign in to prepare a private packet.
packet.offline: Reconnect to view or change the private trip packet.
packet.off: Off. No private packet is scheduled.
packet.paused: Paused. Confirmed tags and receipt references are kept, but no packet is prepared.
packet.active: Active. A private packet is ready.
packet.waiting: Active. Waiting for the monthly check or sufficient confirmed evidence.
packet.clear: Turn off and clear private packet
packet.zoneHint: Use the IANA time zone for this logbook, such as America/New_York.
packet.consent: Use this vehicle’s completed drives and the purposes and receipts I explicitly enter to prepare private monthly packets.
packet.selectDrive: Select a drive to confirm its purpose
packet.noDrives: No completed drives are in this view. Change the range in View settings to find a drive.
packet.entryUnavailable: This drive is not available for a private classification.
packet.receiptHint: Enter only receipts you matched to this drive. Use the date on the receipt and its original currency. No files are uploaded.
packet.invalidReceipt: Complete each receipt with a date, reference, three-letter currency and valid positive amount.
packet.removeAssociations: Saving a different purpose removes this drive’s receipt references from private packets.
packet.ready: Business trip packet ready to review
packet.why: Why this? Each included drive was explicitly marked Business for this packet. Unclassified drives and unmatched receipts are not included in the exported business totals. No tax or reimbursement eligibility is inferred.
packet.noReceipts: No receipt references were matched. This packet can still include confirmed business distance.
packet.exportDetail: Download the reviewed JSON packet to this device? It contains your confirmed business drives and receipt references. Nothing is sent to another recipient.
packet.clearDetail: Stop checks and remove private tags and receipt references? Your original drives and browser-local logbook will be kept.

logbook.title: Trip logbook
logbook.subtitle: Classify drives for tax deduction and expense reimbursement
logbook.suggestionBanner: {{count}} unclassified drives match routes you have already classified.
logbook.noDrives: No drives in this period yet.
logbook.noneInFilter: No drives in this category yet.

brief.categoryDistance: Distance in this category within the selected period.
brief.rateBasis: Existing reimbursement rate × drive distance; rates remain stored per kilometre.
brief.countBasis: Classified drives in the selected period, before the table category filter.
brief.description: Category distances, reimbursement amounts, and drive counts share the selected period; table filters do not change these totals.
brief.provenance: Returned vehicle drives, local classifications, and saved reimbursement rates; complete server-range coverage is not supplied.
